work_unit: Investigate reported LicenceIQ API endpoint failures

dispatch.scope: Backend route registration, credential contracts, error mapping, and offline endpoint checks
dispatch.outcome: accepted after coordinator verification; no backend route defect found

dispatch.scope: Frontend request paths, credentials, response contracts, and recovery behavior
dispatch.outcome: accepted after coordinator inspection; retained successful reading state after a later extraction or fields failure

findings.routing: All document and auth routes are registered. CORS accepts the local browser origin and document-capability header. Static action path segments are not shadowed by the document ID route.
findings.authentication: The running frontend and backend both use hybrid mode. Guest documents require X-Document-Capability; signed-in documents require Authorization Bearer JWT. The two credentials are not interchangeable.
findings.safe_runtime_checks: Health returned 200. Unknown-document read, extract, and fields requests returned controlled DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND 404 responses. CORS preflight returned 200.
findings.provider_check: A live extraction request using only short fictional text completed successfully, which proves the configured key, model, network path, and strict extraction schema are working.
findings.specific_document_state: A local metadata-only lookup of the supplied document returned UPLOADED. It does not yet have a completed reading, so structured extraction correctly cannot run and returns READING_REQUIRED until the read/OCR request succeeds.
findings.live_document_limit: The supplied read request was not replayed because it would send an uploaded licence image to the external OCR provider and requires explicit confirmation for that exact payload.

verification.backend: 185 focused offline API tests and Ruff checks passed in the backend audit. Coordinator also ran 70 focused document lifecycle/question tests, which passed.
verification.frontend: Coordinator ran TypeScript, scoped ESLint, Prettier, and diff checks after the recovery fix; all passed.
verification.runtime: OpenAPI lists 14 application paths, local safe route/CORS probes behaved as expected, the fictional provider extraction succeeded, and the supplied document was confirmed as UPLOADED rather than READ.
